get.description: Personal tokens require vocabularies:read. Lists one section's entries with their ids, for use wherever a record names a type, label, tag, or rule: profile-modules, gender-options, contact-method-types, contact-labels, activity-types, emotion-options, life-event-types, relationship-types, pet-categories, reminder-rules, or tags. These are administrative vocabularies: the token's issuer must currently be an owner or admin of the token's workspace, and is otherwise forbidden. The section's capabilities say whether it takes new entries; each entry's capabilities and referenceCount say whether it may be renamed, reordered, disabled (archived), made the default, deleted, or deleted only with a replacement. emotion-options and pet-categories are read-only. A name already used in the section conflicts. These are administrative vocabularies: the token's issuer must currently be an owner or admin of the token's workspace, and is otherwise forbidden. Does not grant read access. Cookie-authenticated writes require the exact configured Origin; bearer writes require no Cookie or Origin.
